relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast to the CFAR group, significant increases were observed in the latency time of RA rats treated with DHZ, suggesting a reduction in thermal and mechanical hyperalgesia (Figure 2A and B).

key_findings: DHZ (100 mg/kg) ameliorated arthritis severity and hyperalgesia in CFA-induced arthritic rats.
DHZ reduced serum TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, VEGF and MDA and increased SOD and GSH.
